subheadline: Thermal Engineering Firm in Guelph, Ontario
policyStatement: ITS is committed to provide a high degree of value in products and services through dedication to quality, continual improvement and risk based thinking. To achieve these objectives, it is our policy to:
policyDirectives: Understand customer needs and accordingly design products to meet or exceed customer’s requirements for heat sinks and thermal management products for electronics;
Extend excellent customer support and service at all times; and
Seek opportunities for development and improvement of products, manufacturing methods and resources.

principles.title: Customer Focus
principles.description: Understanding customer requirements and delivering solutions that meet or exceed expectations.

principles.title: Continuous Improvement
principles.description: Improving our products, manufacturing processes, and operational efficiency.

principles.title: Precision Manufacturing
principles.description: Producing high-quality thermal management solutions through controlled manufacturing processes.

principles.title: Engineering Excellence
principles.description: Designing innovative thermal solutions for demanding applications across multiple industries.

isoScope: Design, manufacture and delivery of air cooled and liquid cooled heat sinks, and heat pipes, for the electronics industry.
